_about: Kvinesdal Ninja Warrior commentary (job ninjacomm). Generated by build/ninja/make_commentary.py. Fictional original commentators; voices via build/ninja/make_voices.py -> voice/ninja/<id>.m4a. Engine: block /* ninjacomm */, interface: build/ninja/EVENTS.md.

lines.t: Good evening, Kvinesdal! Welcome to the biggest night in the valley! I'm Brock Hollister!
And I'm Tank Mulligan. Brock, I've seen a lot of courses. I have never seen one in the middle of nowhere.
Nowhere is the new somewhere, Tank! Look at that rig! Look at those beams!
I can see those beams from space. Probably. Somebody's going to ask about the electricity bill.
Folks, here is your course. The warped wall. Floating steps. Devil steps. Spinning logs.
Then the salmon ladder, a giant pendulum, a cargo net, and a rope swing. Nobody asked for that rope swing.
Balance beams, a spinning bridge, a slider, and then the one and only MEGA WALL!
Ten seconds on the clock for the Mega Wall? No. Just no. But go ahead, rookie.
Fall in the water and you start from your last checkpoint. The water is warm. Mostly. It's steaming!
That is Norway steam, Brock. It's not warm. It's just confused.
And we're back! The crowd is on its feet! Who's going to run?
Back again! I like it. Persistence, or no hobbies.
Another run on the Kvinesdal course! Step up to the line!
Warm up those fingers. Your forearms will send you a bill later.
Hello, Chris! The crowd knows your name!
Hello, Martin! Look at the crowd, they can't wait!
Chris is here. The pool is nervous.
Martin's back. The pool is ready. The pool is always ready.
First time on the course? Hold forward to run, and tap jump at the end of every platform!
Hold the grab button on a bar and you hang there. Let go at the right moment. That's the whole sport.
Your grip bar drains while you hang! Don't hang around!
Pro tip: the water is wet. Avoid the water.
Checkpoints are glowing gates. Pass one and a fall only sends you back there!
Slow is smooth and smooth is fast. And also slow is slow. But alive.
Try runner vision, folks! Hit the vision key and the next grip points light up!
Runner vision. It shows you where to go. It does not show you how. That's on you.
Runner vision paints your route in light! Follow the glow!
I use runner vision. Don't tell anyone. Everybody does.
Lost? Runner vision. Stuck? Runner vision. Tired? Runner vision won't help.
That glow is your friend. Be nice to the glow.
THREE!
Three!
Three, folks!
TWO!
Two!
Two, here we go!
ONE!
One!
One!
GO GO GO!
AND WE'RE OFF!
GO, RUNNER, GO!
Here we go. Deep breath. Mostly for me.
Eyes on the first obstacle! Stay smooth!
Clock's running. So is the runner. Hopefully in the right direction.
The crowd is roaring! This is the moment!
No pressure. Only a thousand cheering strangers and a steaming pool.
Chris on the line! Let's see it!
Martin on the line! Let's see what he's got!
The WARPED WALL! Sprint and jump, get that hand over the top!
Here comes the warped wall! Momentum, runner, momentum!
Warped wall! Four and a half metres of pure attitude!
That wall has ended better runners than you, buddy.
Over the wall! Clean as a whistle!
Warped wall DONE! He makes it look easy!
The FLOATING STEPS! Small platforms, big nerves!
Now the floating steps! Don't look down. Okay, look down once.
Floating steps! Step, step, step! Don't think!
Steps cleared! That's a dance move!
Nice feet on the floating steps!
The DEVIL STEPS! Leaping uphill, folks! This will hurt!
Devil steps coming up! Tank, how do your legs feel?
Here we go, the devil steps! Stay on your toes!
Devil steps conquered! The devil sends his regards!
He's through the devil steps! Unreal!
The SPINNING LOGS! They turn, he turns, everybody turns!
Spinning logs! Light feet, runner, light feet!
Logs ahead! Never stop moving on a log!
Logs done! Not a splinter!
He rolled over the logs like a lumberjack!
The SALMON LADDER! Up the rungs, like a fish with a plan!
Salmon ladder! Swing, lift, catch, again!
Here comes the salmon ladder! Pure upper body, Tank!
Salmon ladder. I once tried this. We don't talk about it.
Salmon ladder CLEARED! Fish out of water, but in style!
Up the ladder and off! Beautiful!
The GIANT PENDULUM! That red and white pole is swinging for you!
Pendulum! Time your jump, runner! Time it!
Look at that giant pendulum! It's like a clock with an attitude!
Don't stand under that pendulum. Or in front of it. Or near it.
Pendulum beaten! That's timing!
He jumped the pendulum right on the beat!
The CARGO NET CLIMB! Up, up, up!
Cargo net! Fingers in, feet out, climb!
The cargo net! A long way up, folks!
Net's conquered! Straight to the top!
Cargo net done! That's pure grit!
The ROPE SWING! Grab, swing, let go!
Rope swing! Commit to the swing, runner!
Here's the rope swing! Tarzan would be jealous!
Rope swing, nailed it! That's the leap of the night!
He flies through the air with the greatest of ease!
The BALANCE BEAMS! Narrow and mean!
Balance beams! Arms out, eyes forward!
Beams ahead! One wrong step and it's swimming time!
Across the beams! Not a wobble!
Balance beams: done. He's a tightrope walker!
The SPINNING BRIDGE! It turns, the runner runs!
Spinning bridge! Run with it, not against it!
Look at that spinning bridge go! Hold on, Tank!
Bridge cleared! The world kept spinning, he didn't!
He's across the spinning bridge! Super smooth!
The SLIDER! Hop on and hang on!
Slider time! Whee, as they say! Don't say whee!
Here comes the slider! Faster than a Norwegian ski jumper!
Slider conquered! Whoosh!
Off the slider, and flying!
The MEGA WALL! The final test, folks! Up it goes!
Mega wall! Eight metres of Kvinesdal! Can he make it?
THE MEGA WALL! This is where legends are made!
I'd say good luck, but luck has nothing to do with it. Okay, a little.
MEGA WALL CONQUERED! WHAT A RUN!
He's on top of the mega wall! Hit that buzzer!
Clean! Not a hair out of place!
That's what we call a pro move. Remember it.
Textbook! Absolutely textbook!
I've seen sleepy bears move less than that. Smooth.
No wasted movement! That's ninja style!
Sweet. Now do that nine more times.
WHOA! A big wobble! He's hanging on!
Oh, my goodness. That was close. My heart did a thing.
That was CLOSE! Catch it, runner, catch it!
Somebody up there likes this runner.
He saved it! He saved it!
That's what I call an unplanned dance.
Wobble city! But he's still alive!
Don't look down. The pool is looking up.
His grip is running out! Come on, come on, come ON!
The fingers are going. Everybody feel that?
Hanging by a thread, folks! Move!
Grip bar's nearly empty. Let go, or wait for the pool.
Get to the next bar, runner! Get there!
I'm hanging with him. My hands hurt just watching.
OHHHH! He's in the drink!
And there goes the splash. Right on schedule.
He's in the water! Down she goes!
He slipped. The pool wins again.
Splashdown! That's the end of the run, folks!
Brrr. Even the steam looked sorry.
He fell! Back to the checkpoint!
I give that dive a six. Points for style.
Oh no! A huge splash!
And Kvinesdal's pool claims another victim.
So close! He'll be back!
It's okay. It's only freezing. I mean, warm. I mean, steaming.
Chris is in the water. Chris, the water says hello.
Martin took a swim! Martin, how's the water?
Chris goes down! Chris, get up, shake it off!
Martin slips! Martin, get back in there!
Checkpoint reached! Now a fall only sets him back here!
Safe for now. Take a breath, buddy.
Checkpoint! The gate glows, the crowd roars!
Good. Now don't ruin it.
That's a big checkpoint! Pressure relief!
I like checkpoints. They're like cuddles for runners.
Ten seconds on the clock! Hurry, hurry, hurry!
Ten seconds left! Run, buddy, run!
Ten seconds! Make them count!
Tick tock, ten seconds. No pressure.
Three seconds!
Three seconds left!
Three seconds! Move it!
THREE SECONDS!
And the time is up! Heartbreak on the course!
The clock won. The clock always wins.
Out of time! Better luck next run!
HE'S DONE IT! He hits the buzzer!
He's done it! Incredible! Somebody call the neighbours!
FINISH! What a run! What a night!
I'm not crying. It's the steam.
Buzzer! Absolute buzzer! The crowd goes wild!
That is the cleanest finish this valley has ever seen.
He made it! Slow, but he made it! That's grit!
That wasn't fast. But it was finished. I'll take it.
Over the line! That's what counts!
A NEW PERSONAL BEST! Look at that clock!
New personal best! Faster than yesterday! Faster than a moose on ice!
PERSONAL BEST, folks! He's improving!
That's a personal best. I'd clap, but I'm holding a coffee.
A personal best on the board! The crowd loves it!
Look at that time. That's a personal best, and a personal brag.
CHRIS takes the top spot! Martin, your record just fell!
Martin, you might want to sit down. Chris just beat your time.
Chris on top of the leaderboard! History is made!
Chris wins this round. Martin, redemption is a thing.
MARTIN takes the throne! Chris, your record is gone!
Chris, bad news. Martin just beat your time. Good luck explaining that.
Martin on top of the leaderboard! What a performance!
Martin wins this round. Chris, time to train.
It's Chris versus Martin tonight, Tank! Who has the best time?
Chris says him. Martin says him. The scoreboard says: run again.
Brother versus brother. This is better than television.
Better than television is right! Look at that board!
The leaderboard is wide open! Chris, Martin, show us what you've got!
Winner gets bragging rights. Loser buys the cookies.
And a bot runner steps up! Let's see how he handles the course!
The bots are running too. They don't complain about the cold.
A bot on the course! The crowd loves it!
And another one bites the water.
The bot is in the pool! Wow!
He ran out of battery. Or talent. Hard to tell.
Splash! That's the third bot tonight!
I'd feel sorry for him, but he's a bot.
He fell! The crowd gasps!
The bot cleared it! Look at that!
Even the bot's better than me.
A perfect run from the bot! Not bad!
FIRE! Look at those flames!
I felt that in my eyebrows.
Pyro! Fireworks! The whole valley can see it!
That's what they call a warm welcome.
FLAMES, FOLKS! Feel the heat!
Somebody's paying the insurance on that one.
The crowd is going bananas!
Listen to that crowd. They're loud. And quite far from anything.
Nine thousand fans on their feet! Or ninety, from here!
The crowd's having a good time. So am I.
What an atmosphere!
Look at those waving hands! Lovely.
Look at those beams! They go all the way up!
I bet they can see those lights from the whole valley. Somebody's going to complain.
The light show is incredible tonight!
Strobes, beams, fog. If I had a disco ball I'd be happy.
Tank, what are you eating?
Brunost. Brown cheese. It tastes like caramel that made a bad decision.
Brock, did you try the lutefisk?
I did. I'm still thinking about it.
That's the lye talking.
Kvinesdal, are you ready?!
KVINESDAL!
That's the spirit, Tank!
I put my hand in the pool. It's warm.
It's steaming, Tank!
And I'm still cold. Explain that.
Tank, how's the weather out here?
Minus eleven and I've lost the feeling in my ears.
What ears?
I've never seen so many sweaters in one place.
That's Norwegian fashion, Tank! Warm and wild!
Fun fact, folks. This course was built overnight!
By who? Elves? Trolls? Nobody will say.
Brock, where are we, exactly?
In Kvinesdal, Tank!
Yes, but where in Kvinesdal?
Great question! Next question!
I could do this course, Tank.
You couldn't do the stairs to the booth.
That's a lie!
Do you hear that?
The crowd?
No. The silence beyond it. Creepy.
Tank, give me your hot take.
The pool is too cold, the course is too high, and the cookies are too good.
My grandmother could run this course.
Tank, your grandmother is a legend.
She'd also beat you at cards.
A big shoutout to the crew who built this!
And to the snow that stayed on it.
I'm told there's a troll under the Mega Wall.
Tank, there's no troll.
That's what the troll wants you to think.
Another cup of coffee, Tank?
It's my ninth. I can see through time.
What's the secret to a good run, Brock?
Cookies. Lots of cookies.
Wise words. Terrible athlete.
Nobody on the course right now, folks! Come on, somebody step up!
It's quiet. I could take a nap. I will take a nap.
The pool is waiting! The course is ready!
Anybody? Anybody at all? I see you in the dark.
The lights are on! The beams are sweeping! Who's going to run?
I've counted the stars three times. Still nobody.
This is Kvinesdal Ninja Warrior! The course is open!
I'm told the pool is warm. Somebody check. Not me.
Step up to the start gate, folks! Step right up!
I'm not paid by the hour. But I'd still like a runner.
Chris? Martin? Anybody? The course is lonely!
Fresh snow, hot pool, empty course. This is peaceful. And a little sad.
A runner approaches the start gate!
Look at this one. Confident walk. Probably lost.
And that's the show, folks! Thanks for coming to Kvinesdal Ninja Warrior!
Come back and fall in again. We'll be here.
Goodnight, Kvinesdal!
He barely made that one!
That was a heartbeat from disaster.
Fingertips! Pure fingertips!
Next up! Ola Bakken, a dairy farmer who says his cows time his sprints!
How are the cows? Impressed? They never are.
And Ola goes in! Somewhere, a cow is not surprised.
OLA FINISHES! The cows will hear about this tonight!
Here's Sigrid Kvam, lighthouse keeper, from a town with no sea!
She says the light is her whole personality. I believe her.
Sigrid is in the water! The lighthouse has gone dark!
Sigrid finishes! Somebody switch on the beam. I would.
Torvald Nissen, three-time bun-eating champion, steps up!
Carbs. That's his plan. Also his only plan.
Torvald takes a swim. Please, nobody throw him a bun.
TORVALD DOES IT! That is pure bun power!
Ingrid Fossum! She trains on her neighbour's goat fence!
The goats are in the crowd. They look nervous.
Ingrid is down! And the goats gasp!
Ingrid clears the lot. Goat fence training works.
Bjorn Aasen is here to win a bet with his brother-in-law!
Bad news for the brother-in-law. Worse news for Bjorn's knees.
Bjorn is in the pool. I think the brother-in-law just won.
BJORN FINISHES! Pay up, brother-in-law!
Kari Mo, retired postwoman! She has outrun every dog in the county!
Dogs, geese, and one very angry mayor.
Kari splashes down! No dog ever managed that!
Kari Mo crosses the line. Special delivery.
Lars-Erik Tveit! His mother is in the crowd with a thermos!
No pressure, Lars-Erik. Just a thermos. Of love.
Lars-Erik is in! Somewhere, a thermos is being unscrewed.
LARS-ERIK HITS THE BUZZER! Mama needs a bigger thermos!
Hanne Dahl, reigning village snow-shovelling champion!
Shovelling is basically ninja training. With more complaining.
Hanne hits the water! Even champions get wet!
Hanne Dahl, ladies and gentlemen. Clean as fresh snow.
The next runner is walking up to the gate, folks!
I count about a dozen runners left tonight. I have lost count twice.
Fresh legs coming up! The leaderboard is hungry!
Somebody tell the pool to stop smiling.
The field is strong tonight, Tank!
The field is also cold. It is the same field.
A new time to beat on the board, folks!
Somebody get that runner a medal. Or a blanket.
The leaderboard has changed! We have a new leader!
Leaders get a thermos. Those are the rules.
Look closely, folks! A ghost runner is out there, running your best time!
A ghost. On a ninja course. Of course.
The ghost of your best run is on the course! Catch it!
The ghost is ahead! Catch up!
You are losing to yourself. That is a new low.
Ghost in the lead! Dig deep!
You're ahead of the ghost! Keep that gap!
You are beating your past self. Gloat quietly.
The ghost is chasing you! Don't look back!
